# Render3D Core Profile 1

Profile hash: `150c6f4b4170909f394b2055decabceed0d2b7258624544d515a1cba9330a454`

A conforming backend implements every entry below. `Unsupported` is reserved for extensions
added after Profile 1 and may never be returned for anything in it.

The OWNER decides which checks apply: `backend` features need a handler in every backend, and
the rest are implemented once above a backend and a rasteriser never sees them.
